_comment: Derived from Nepali TTS dataset c100
-speaking_rate: Nepali syllable rate is :4-6 syllables/sec vs English phoneme rate ~10-14/sec.
Bins are tightened around a lower centre point.
-pitch: Nepali female speakers tend toward higher pitch; male slightly lower than English average.
-SNR / c50 / sdr bins are audio-quality metrics and are language-agnostic : kept same as upstream.
HOW TO RECALIBRATE ON YOUR OWN DATA:
Run scripts/compute_bin_edges_nepali.py (provided separately) on your annotated dataset
to recompute percentile-based edges from the actual distribution. Replace the values below.
So long as the text label arrays in v01_text_bins_nepali.json have the same number of entries as the edge arrays here,
FORMAT: each key maps to a list of N-1 thresholds that define N bins.
The text label arrays in v01_text_bins_nepali.json must have exactly N entries per key.
